PrivateType is a private, local push-to-talk dictation app for Windows. Hold a shortcut, speak, and release it to insert text into the field where dictation began—without cloud recognition or transcript history.

This draft supersedes the v1.0.3 test build.

## Fixes in this draft

### Correct Windows taskbar identity

- Restored the PrivateType icon for setup and application windows on the Windows taskbar.
- PrivateType now establishes one stable Windows taskbar identity before opening any window.

### Truthful startup errors

- When another PrivateType copy is already using every configured dictation shortcut, the error now explains the shortcut conflict and how to resolve it.
- The writable-folder guidance now appears only when PrivateType actually cannot use its portable data folder.

## Also included from v1.0.3

- New installations store the verified speech model once in a per-user cache under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PrivateType\models`, allowing cache-aware PrivateType versions to reuse it.
- Concurrent PrivateType processes coordinate the model download instead of downloading duplicate copies.
- Existing release folders and their models remain untouched. An existing v1.0.2 model is not migrated or deleted.
- Creating an empty `app\models` directory before first launch selects portable-local model storage for that release folder.
- Windows startup registration follows the selected PrivateType version and safely removes obsolete LiveDictation registration.

## Download and start

1. Download `PrivateType-1.0.4-win-x64.zip` and `PrivateType-1.0.4-win-x64.zip.sha256` below.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Extract the complete ZIP into a writable folder.
4. Open `PrivateType 1.0.4` and double-click `PrivateType.exe`.
5. Approve the separate local speech-model download on first launch if the verified model is not already in the shared cache.

The model is not bundled in the ZIP. PrivateType downloads it directly from NVIDIA on Hugging Face and verifies its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before use.

## Requirements

- 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11
- A modern x64 CPU and at least 4 GB RAM; 8 GB or more is recommended
- About 2 GB free disk space for the portable app, model, and working room
- [Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015–2022 (x64)](https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe)

## Privacy

Speech recognition runs locally. PrivateType has no account, cloud-recognition fallback, telemetry, retained audio, or transcript history. Review diagnostic reports before sharing them because application diagnostics can still contain information about your computer environment.
